source: Design of 2026-11-05 (35 criteria, axes, classes, profiles, cumulative tiers), frozen with runward-assess 0.1.0. A change that can move a result opens grille@2; a correction that cannot opens grille@1.(m+1). Thresholds live in the conditions below, never in code.

profiles.L: CLI or library published in a registry
profiles.A: agentic system: calls a model or executes tools at run time

classes.M: mechanical: computed from the repository tree at one commit with pinned tools; replayable on a past commit
classes.X: external snapshot: read from a captured file (API, registry, site) with its request, status and sha256; never re-collectable after the fact
classes.J: judged: annex with fixed questions and scales, judge identified; never in a tier
classes.noisy: sub-class of M or X whose value varies with equal input (durations, model scores): an indicator with N runs and dispersion, outside the tiers

rules.axisTier: the highest P such that every applicable criterion's every tier <= P is met
rules.noVacuity: a tier with no applicable criterion caps the axis at the tier below; an axis whose every criterion is na reads na
rules.blocking: na does not block; not-observed and error block and are counted apart from not-met
rules.noComposite: no global score, no average, no composite percentage; the face is the vector of axis tiers and its regressions
rules.comparability: two results compare only when (id, rev) are equal
rules.coverage: a record carries every criterion of the version, or the score refuses to emit

criteria.title: The test suite passes, stably
criteria.procedure: 3 x test_cmd in the reference container; each JUnit normalised to a census (case, verdict); a timeout is never a pass

P1.text: at least one case; run 1 without failure

P2.text: three runs without failure, identical censuses

criteria.positiveControl: a fixture with a random test: P2 not met; a test past its timeout never counts green

criteria.title: Statement and branch coverage

applies.naReason: no free coverage tool exists for the language (the reason OpenSSF Best Practices accepts)

criteria.procedure: test_cmd with the pinned coverage tool; lcov or cobertura read for statements and branches

P1.text: a coverage report is produced

P2.text: >= 80 % of statements (OpenSSF Best Practices silver)

criteria.positiveControl: a fixture covered at 79 %: P2 not met; at 91 % statements and 79 % branches: P3 not met

criteria.title: The tests catch sabotaged code
criteria.procedure: exhaustive, no sample: every source file of the declared perimeter (perimetre_sabotage) has its exported function bodies replaced by a neutral stub, and the suite runs on a fresh copy; a file whose suite stays green is a hole

P2.text: >= 80 % of the perimeter's files turn the suite red

criteria.positiveControl: a fixture whose tests assert nothing: 0 % caught; a well-tested fixture: 100 %

criteria.title: The build is reproducible

applies.naReason: no build step (OpenSSF Best Practices build_reproducible)

criteria.procedure: two clean builds in the reference container, a third on a second environment, compared with the published digest

P2.text: build 1 equals build 2

P3.text: the second environment's build equals the published digest

criteria.positiveControl: a fixture that embeds its build date: P2 not met

criteria.title: Evaluations of the agentic behaviour
criteria.procedure: evaluation set versioned in the repository (profile: evals.set), runner declared (evals.runner), exact model id recorded, per-case outputs archived; the score is a noisy indicator, outside the tiers

P1.text: set and runner present, the set's digest recorded

P2.text: run at the assessed commit, model pinned, outputs archived

P3.text: the deterministic guards (validation, routing, refusal) have tests, green with no model call

criteria.positiveControl: a fixture whose guard calls the model: P3 not met (the test runs without model access)

criteria.title: Reliability in operation

applies.naReason: an agentic system that deploys no service

criteria.procedure: SLO declared in data (profile: slo_file); export of the SLI and of the deployment and incident logs over the window

P1.text: an SLO declared in data (objective, SLI query)

P2.text: the SLI export attached; the SLO held over the window

P3.text: change failure rate, recovery time and rework computed from the logs, with their denominators (indicators, never targets: DORA)

criteria.positiveControl: a log without denominator (deployments not listed): P3 not met

criteria.title: Mutation (an instrument, never a tier: runward ADR-0046)
criteria.procedure: the language's mutation tool, pinned, on perimetre_mutation, at tag records only; the committed survivors register is read for its counts

criteria.title: Coordinated disclosure
criteria.procedure: SECURITY.md read for a channel and for delays in days; the forge's private vulnerability reporting setting

P1.text: SECURITY.md with a contact channel

P2.text: private reporting enabled; delays written in days

criteria.positiveControl: a SECURITY.md with no channel: P1 not met

criteria.title: What is installed is what was tested; the product's SBOM
criteria.procedure: fresh install from the registry (L) or image build (W) in a sandbox; the resolved tree compared with the tag's lockfile; SBOM attached to the release

P1.text: a versioned lockfile; an install from it succeeds

P2.text: installed tree equals the tested lock (0 diverging version)

P3.text: an SBOM attached to the release, naming the product and its version, components equal to the installed tree

criteria.positiveControl: a fixture published without shrinkwrap with a ranged dependency: P2 not met

criteria.title: Known vulnerabilities; visibility of the project's advisories
criteria.procedure: every package@version of the lockfile at the commit queried in OSV; a known vulnerable control queried in the same batch (the base is blind without it); the project's published advisories looked up in the GitHub database and in OSV; affected npm versions checked for deprecation

P1.text: 0 high or critical vulnerability without a written exception (reason, date)

P2.text: 0 vulnerability open more than 30 days after its advisory was published (dates read in the snapshot)

P3.text: every advisory the project published is visible in a global database and its affected versions are deprecated

na.reason: the project has published no advisory (read in the snapshot)

criteria.positiveControl: the control package returns nothing: every SEC-03 fact is not-observed (blind base)

criteria.title: Static analysis and secrets
criteria.procedure: every blob reachable from the commit scanned with the grid's fixed secret patterns (secret-patterns@1), after a planted control is seen; SAST with rules pinned by digest

P1.text: 0 secret detected outside motivated exceptions

P2.text: 0 high-severity SAST result without a motivated exception

criteria.positiveControl: a fixture with a fake key of a known format in its history: P1 not met

criteria.title: Hardened CI; Scorecard
criteria.procedure: the grid's workflow reader on .github/workflows (W1 pull_request_target that checks out the head, W2 action not pinned by a full SHA, W3 no top-level permissions or write-all); the OpenSSF Scorecard result whose commit is the assessed one, version recorded

P1.text: 0 high finding in the workflows (dangerous triggers, unpinned actions, broad permissions)

P2.text: Scorecard: no critical- or high-risk check at 0, Code-Review and Contributors excepted (counted in GOU)

P3.text: every check >= 8, the same two excepted

criteria.positiveControl: a fixture with pull_request_target and a checkout of the head: P1 not met
criteria.comparison: two Scorecard results of different versions: marked 'tool differs', no transition counted

criteria.title: Provenance of the deliverables

applies.naReason: nothing is published: no image (W) and no package (A)

criteria.procedure: attestation verified offline against a captured trust root with the signer workflow pinned; the signing job read statically

P2.text: provenance verified offline, signer workflow pinned

P3.text: the job that holds the signing token runs no install and no test (read in the workflow)

criteria.positiveControl: an artefact changed by one byte: verification refused; a signing job that runs npm ci: P3 not met

criteria.title: Agentic surface
criteria.procedure: a tool manifest in data (profile: tools_manifest); every tool the code registers (profile: tools_pattern) must be in it; a fixed corpus of untrusted inputs replayed against the guards; tool execution tested without network

P1.text: a tool manifest, present and complete (every tool the code registers is in it)

P2.text: 100 % of the corpus refused by the deterministic guards

P3.text: egress outside the allow-list fails the test

criteria.positiveControl: a fixture with a tool missing from the manifest: P1 not met

criteria.title: Web surface
criteria.procedure: each production URL (deploie_service) fetched once: TLS protocol and certificate validity, security headers; a pinned dynamic baseline scan

P1.text: 0 high TLS or header finding (TLS below 1.2, invalid certificate, no HSTS)

P2.text: 0 high alert in a baseline dynamic scan

criteria.positiveControl: a test URL with no security header: P1 not met

criteria.title: Governance files
criteria.procedure: a licence file recognised as an SPDX identifier; README, CONTRIBUTING (public repositories), SECURITY; GOVERNANCE with fixed sections (roles, decisions, succession)

P1.text: recognised SPDX licence, README, CONTRIBUTING (if public), SECURITY

P2.text: GOVERNANCE with roles, decision-making and succession

criteria.positiveControl: a fixture without SECURITY.md: P1 not met

criteria.title: Independent review and branch protection
criteria.procedure: the default branch's effective rules (rulesets and classic protection); pull requests merged between the two window bounds, approved by a human other than their author

P1.text: force-push and deletion refused on the default branch; at least one required status check

P2.text: >= 50 % of the window's changes approved by another human (OpenSSF Best Practices gold two_person_review)

P3.text: review required by the forge, administrators included, and >= 90 % of the changes reviewed

criteria.positiveControl: a pull request approved by its own author or by a bot: not counted

criteria.title: Continuity of access
criteria.procedure: human administrators of the repository; owners of the published package; type of the owning account

P2.text: >= 2 human administrators of the repository and of the package (OpenSSF Best Practices silver access_continuity)

P3.text: the owner is an organisation, not a personal account

criteria.positiveControl: two accounts of one person (mailmap): counted once

criteria.title: Dependence on few people (CHAOSS)
criteria.procedure: git log --use-mailmap between the window bounds, merges excluded, the grid's fixed bot list excluded; absence factor and elephant factor at 50 % (organisation = e-mail domain, a free-mail or noreply domain counts the person alone); identities hashed, never written

P2.text: absence factor >= 2

criteria.positiveControl: a fixture where a bot makes 60 % of the commits: the factor is computed without it

criteria.title: Decisions recorded and kept current
criteria.procedure: every ADR of the journals (runward/adr, docs/adr, doc/adr, adr) parsed: a status in a closed list, a dated re-evaluation trigger; a trigger is overdue when its latest date is before the commit's date and no later date appears in the record

P1.text: a decision journal, 100 % of its statuses readable

P2.text: every ADR has a dated trigger; 0 overdue trigger without a dated note

criteria.positiveControl: an ADR whose trigger is dated the day before, with no note: P2 not met

criteria.title: Versions and support
criteria.procedure: tags merged into the commit and CHANGELOG headings at the commit, against the versions the registry published before the commit's date; a support policy in data (support.json)

P1.text: every published version has a tag and a CHANGELOG entry

P2.text: a support policy in data, consistent with the registry

P3.text: at least one fix backported to a maintained line during the window

criteria.positiveControl: a version published without a tag: P1 not met

criteria.title: Traceability from requirement or decision to evidence
criteria.procedure: a machine-readable trace: the rule tables of a runward mission's five gated manifests, or a trace file (profile: trace_file); every pointer resolved at the commit by this package's own reader (file, symbol, JUnit case, ADR)

P1.text: a trace with stable identifiers

P2.text: 100 % of the pointers resolved

criteria.positiveControl: a pointer to a renamed symbol: P2 not met

criteria.title: The cited evidence is fresh
criteria.procedure: every machine report the repository cites (JUnit, SARIF, coverage) regenerated during the measure and compared by census and verdicts (the freshness recipe), never by bytes

P3.text: 0 difference between the cited reports and the regenerated ones

criteria.positiveControl: a cited case removed from the suite with the committed report unchanged: P3 not met

criteria.title: The declared gate withstands the sabotage catalogue
criteria.procedure: the gate pinned at the commit (the runward version of the lockfile, or the CLI built from the commit for runward itself), run offline on the commit's mission; its JSON verdict re-derived under two time zones, two locales and, when given, a second runtime; the versioned catalogue saboteur@1 applied case by case on fresh copies

P1.text: the gate is green at the commit

P2.text: the verdict re-derived offline, byte for byte

P3.text: every must-refuse case refused, no refusal on the legitimate rename or on an invariance case

criteria.positiveControl: the catalogue replays the healthy mission and the legitimate rename: a refusal on either is a false red, P3 not met

criteria.title: Defect register
criteria.procedure: the register declared in the profile (defect_register) parsed with closed fields (id, class, effect, affected-from, fixed-in, found-by, advisory); an entry is unclassified when its advisory reads unclassified; a fixed entry must name a regression test that exists

P1.text: a register, 100 % of its entries parsed

P2.text: 0 entry unclassified for more than 30 days (before the commit's date)

P3.text: every fixed defect names a regression test that exists

criteria.positiveControl: an entry without a class field: P1 not met

criteria.title: The regulatory texts cited are current
criteria.procedure: each declared conformity document is data naming its text and that text's version; compared with a snapshot of the amending acts (EUR-Lex)

P1.text: identifier and version cited in data

P2.text: 0 document behind a captured amending act

criteria.positiveControl: a document citing a text without its latest amending act: P2 not met

criteria.title: Factual statements tagged and checked (runward ADR-0092)
criteria.procedure: the declared public surfaces captured (repository files at the commit, site pages in the snapshot); a fixed lexical detector counts factual sentences (a number next to a noun, or a version); a claims register with closed types and checkers

P1.text: the surfaces captured, the count of untagged factual sentences published

P2.text: a claims register, 0 typed claim false

P3.text: 0 untagged factual sentence in the declared zones

criteria.positiveControl: a version-ref claim naming a version that is not the published one: P2 not met

criteria.title: Public numbers are consistent
criteria.procedure: a fixed list of public facts declared in the profile (public_facts), each with a source of truth computed in the tree and a fixed pattern; every surface read for each pattern

P2.text: 0 difference between surfaces and with the source of truth

criteria.positiveControl: two pages giving two different numbers of rules: P2 not met

criteria.title: Overpromise lexicon
criteria.procedure: the grid's versioned lexicon (overpromise@1) and the project's own, searched on every declared surface; a sentence that negates the term, by the lexicon's fixed negation list, is counted apart

P1.text: 0 occurrence outside motivated exceptions

criteria.positiveControl: a page that says 'no hallucination': P1 not met

criteria.title: Clean install
criteria.procedure: the documented install method in a blank reference container; a second OS on a pinned runner; duration recorded as a noisy indicator

P1.text: succeeds in the reference container

P2.text: also succeeds on the second OS

criteria.positiveControl: a documented method that assumes a tool absent from the image: P1 not met

criteria.title: The documented start runs as written; links
criteria.procedure: command blocks of fixed sections (Quickstart, first steps) run in a sandbox and their documented outputs compared; relative links of every Markdown file resolved in the tree; external links checked

P1.text: every command exits as documented; 0 broken internal link

P2.text: documented outputs found; 0 broken external link

criteria.positiveControl: a documented command whose real output differs: P1 not met

criteria.title: The documented interface is the real one
criteria.procedure: L: --help options against the reference table; W: the OpenAPI schema against the routes (contract tests); A: tool schemas against the manifest

P2.text: 0 difference

criteria.positiveControl: an option renamed in the code and not in the documentation: P2 not met

criteria.title: Automated accessibility
criteria.procedure: axe-core pinned on a fixed list of pages of the local build, browser pinned

P1.text: 0 critical violation

P2.text: 0 critical or serious violation

criteria.positiveControl: a page with an image without a text alternative: P1 not met

criteria.title: Third-party signals

applies.naReason: a private repository: no third party can see it

criteria.procedure: authors of issues and pull requests opened between the window's dates, the owner, collaborators and the grid's bots excepted; public dependents outside the author's domains; published references

P1.text: >= 1 active third-party human

P2.text: >= 5 third-party humans and >= 1 third-party pull request merged

P3.text: >= 3 public dependents outside the author and >= 1 reference published outside the author's domains

criteria.positiveControl: an issue opened by a collaborator or a bot: not counted

criteria.title: Market indicators
criteria.procedure: downloads of the last closed calendar month; stars and forks; values and differences only, never a tier

rules: fixed questions and scales, versioned in the grid
two independent judgments (two models, or a model and a person); judge, version, digest of the prompt and of the inputs recorded
a disagreement is shown, never averaged, never turned into a tier
an item becomes mechanical (new rev, new class) as soon as a checker exists

items.question: Is the value proposition understood from the home page alone?
Overlap with each actor of the market list
Do provoked errors (outputs captured in M) state the cause and the gesture?
Status of each dated promise of the roadmap
Design review by a person not involved (NIST SSDF PW.2)

scorecardRisk.source: OpenSSF Scorecard docs/checks.md, risk of each check, read 2026-11-05

tables.windowRule: a window runs from the previous record's commit (excluded) to the assessed commit; at the first record, from the 100th first-parent commit before it
tables.referenceDate: an M criterion that needs a date reads the commit's committer date; an X criterion reads the snapshot's as-of date
